## Complaint Compensation  
### What We Can Offer  
**Financial Compensation:**
- Refunds (for financial loss)
- Interest (for delayed refunds)
- Goodwill payments (£20–£100+)  
**Non-Financial Remedies:**
- Apology
- Explanation
- Service improvements
- Policy changes

raw_entities.name: Complaint Compensation Process
raw_entities.description: The process by which the bank offers financial and non-financial remedies to customers following a complaint. Financial compensation includes refunds for losses, interest on delayed refunds, and goodwill payments. Non-financial remedies include apologies, explanations, service improvements, and policy changes.
context: Financial Compensation: Refunds (for financial loss), Interest (for delayed refunds), Goodwill payments (£20–£100+)
Non-Financial Remedies: Apology, Explanation, Service improvements, Policy changes

raw_entities.name: Financial Compensation Offering
raw_entities.description: The step in which the bank determines and offers financial compensation to the customer, including refunds for financial loss, interest on delayed refunds, and goodwill payments ranging from £20 to £100 or more.

raw_entities.name: Non-Financial Remedy Offering
raw_entities.description: The step in which the bank offers non-financial remedies to address the customer's complaint, including apologies, explanations of what went wrong, service improvements, and policy changes to prevent recurrence.

raw_entities.name: Complaint Customer
raw_entities.description: The customer who has filed a complaint and is eligible to receive financial or non-financial compensation as part of the complaint resolution process.
